name: relay
description: Pending-work registry for background agents and tasks. Everything needed to continue after a usage limit (HTTP 429) is saved in the project: a strict registry, the full brief of each agent, partial-report pointers and retry times. A fresh session lists what is due and re-launches from the saved briefs (a stopped subagent cannot be resumed from another session). Optional guarded ship step (pr, merge-ff, tag, release) that runs only pinned commands under a signed, expiring, commit-bound approval. Python standard library only.
